texts.en: Listening to nature sounds (after stress · around tasks)

texts.ko: 지금부터 잔잔한 자연음을 약 4분 동안 듣습니다. 볼륨을 편안한 수준으로 맞추고, 불편하거나 귀가 피로하면 언제든 멈춰 주세요.
texts.en: For about 4 minutes, you'll listen to gentle nature sounds. Set the volume to a comfortable level, and stop anytime if it's uncomfortable or your ears get tired.
Not validated with adults in Korea.
